title: QQ Systems for Spectral Determinants and Integrable Models
exact_target: Explain the origin of the oper spectral-determinant functional relations and find their integrable-model counterpart.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003494 (OWR-15429-009). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Algebraic Groups (2017), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2017/21, pp. 1281--1347. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 50.
Frenkel et al., q-Opers and QQ-Systems (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The extraction does not include the functional relation, Lie type, shifts or normalizations. These are source-defined and must be supplied before using this record as a standalone equation; the two structural questions are retained without inventing a new QQ relation.
